checks: General intake/classification is the default, purchase mapping remains optional
Multi-sheet workbook is broken down into separately classified inventory and production tables
Column primitive types, semantic roles and blank counts are shown without guessing unknown roles
Reasons and previews retain physical sheet, header, row and column references; zero is not blank
Intake does not force purchase mapping or publish observations
Breakdown modal fits 390/768/1440px; wide column tables scroll locally
Editing a suggestion clears confirmation; review cannot be submitted silently
Review persists separately from unchanged inferred metadata, with no observation publication
Review applies only to the chosen table, not automatically to all workbook sheets
Original bytes remain identical and another workspace cannot access the profile
Pusat data opens saved breakdown/review in the raw evidence drawer, including mobile layout
Unknown business datasets abstain explicitly instead of becoming purchase transactions
Unsupported format remains byte-identical raw and is not falsely claimed as classified
Over-budget CSV reports partial observed counts while retaining all original bytes
Identical re-intake records another receipt without erasing review or duplicating the raw version
Browser requests remain same-origin; no AI/CDN/model endpoint is used
